title: Inter at Atalanta: four straight wins in Bergamo, Sučić or Mkhitaryan?
caption:
Inter have won on each of their last four visits to Bergamo, per Inter.it's match guide (Nov 20) — seven wins and a draw in the last eight league games against Atalanta. Sky Sport Italia reports a choice in midfield between Sučić and Mkhitaryan, and a squad that travels only on Sunday (Nov 20, reported, not official). We say Inter make it five straight. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
